dataset_name: Sparkov Credit Card Transaction Fraud Dataset

methodology.read_strategy: pandas chunked CSV reads of 200,000 rows
methodology.missingness: exact null counts from all rows
methodology.duplicate_check: exact 64-bit pandas hashes of transaction IDs; collision risk is negligible but non-zero
methodology.outlier_rule: exact per-file Tukey 1.5*IQR flags for amount and city population; flags are not automatically removed
methodology.test_data_policy: descriptive profiling only; test labels are prohibited from model, feature, hyperparameter, or threshold selection

amt.method: values below Q1 - 1.5*IQR or above Q3 + 1.5*IQR
amt.interpretation: distributional flag, not automatic evidence of invalid data
